label: preparing
what: A discreet large gathering at the town hall at eighteen, supplied with 200 fresh loaves and presented to me as a lighting review. Builder coordinates the hall visit and accepted a 101-emerald debt; baker, innkeeper and freight arrange the bread. Secretary knowingly assists with scheduling and delivery/payment records, though knowledge of the full purpose is uncertain. A celebration of my forty years of service is likely but remains unconfirmed; neighbour and watchman are not established as collaborators.
